newsitem.title: GREECE: ITALIAN NAVY'S AMERIGO VESPUCCI SHIP HEADED FOR PIRAEUS.
newsitem.headline: ITALIAN NAVY'S AMERIGO VESPUCCI SHIP HEADED FOR PIRAEUS.

text.p: Italian navy's training vessel Amerigo Vespucci is expected to anchor in the harbour of Piraeus on Wednesday and Thursday providing a chance for Greek and Italian sailors to meet, the Greek navy headquarters said.

"The ship will tie down at Akti Miaouli in Piraeus and will be open to the public on Wednesday from 1030-1200 and 1430-1830 local and likewise on Thursday. Visits by the public will be especially welcome," it said. --George Georgiopoulos, Athens Newsroom +301 3311812-4
